title: Product Doesn't Last
text: Product Doesn't Last. Product only lasted 4 months while only being used as a clock, no alarm or other features were being used, only has 90 day warranty which is not listed in description.

product_metadata.title: GEARONIC Digital Alarm Clock Wooden Alarm Clock Wood Modern Triangle Alarm Digital Desk Clock, Displays Time Date Temperature Calendar Wood Made Electric Clocks for Bedroom, Bedside - Black
features: MULTI-FUNCTION: Updated version for 7 levels of brightness adjustable display. Sound control function with acoustic sensor, displays time, date, month, temperature (°F), and alarm clock functions with LED lights that glows through the marble pattern finish. Auto Dimming from 6pm to 7am. There are 2 USB output ports on the back (5V, 1A) that allows charging for Android or Apple system smart phones at the same time.

MODERN DESIGN: Modern simplicity design with no buttons or plastic parts located on the front and four sides of the clock. LED light glows through the wooden finish for a clean modern look. Matches perfectly with any modern designed office or home furniture. Clock measures approx. 4. 5 x 3 x 3 inches.

SOUND CONTROL: This product has a sound control function, allowing the clock to go into standby mode after idled for 10 seconds. To activate or deactivate this feature, simply press the "Down" button to toggle On or Off, which are indicated as "ON: Sd" and "-: Sd"
PACKAGE CONTENTS: Wooden Alarm Clock x 1, AC Adapter x 1, USB Charging Cable x 1, User Manual x 1.
